question_text: What tradeoffs matter most in real-time rendering systems?

ranking.answer_fit_rationale: The paper explicitly studies the tradeoff between spatial resolution and temporal resolution under GPU and bandwidth budgets, which is one of the clearest real-time rendering constraints.
ranking.interestingness_rationale: It adds a perceptual dimension: the best tradeoff depends on motion, predictability, blur, and judder rather than raw frame time alone.
ranking.overall_rationale: A precise, high-quality source for the perceptual side of real-time rendering tradeoffs, with a smaller but credible citation signal.

title: A Perceptual Model of Motion Quality for Rendering with Adaptive Refresh-Rate and Resolution
